text:
sasha (People Ops): Quick heads-up — All-Hands is Tuesday 11:00am PT (hybrid). Short agenda draft: 1) State of the company (Sam) 2) Product roadmap highlights + Dedicated/Private launch callouts (Elena) 3) Runtime & infra postmortem recap (Jasper) 4) Policy update highlights (security/compliance) 5) Q&A + shoutouts. Please drop any questions or demo requests here by EOD Friday. RSVP on the calendar: <https://calendar.company/redwood-allhands> :calendar:

sam (CEO): Thanks everyone — I'll cover high-level strategy and where we’re investing next quarter. Quick ask: can Product show the Dedicated rollout timing and fallback plan? That helps the sales/ops teams.

elena (Product): Yep — I can do a 7–8 minute demo + a slide on rollout timeline. Can someone from sales confirm they want a short FAQ intro? @maria

maria (Marketing): I can put together a 1-slide FAQ and a one-pager post-allhands. Also: can we enable captions for the recording? Important for partners.

jasper (Eng): Heads-up — I’ll cover the incident recap from last week and the mitigations we pushed. TL;DR: root cause was a scheduler regression, fixed with canary toggle. Will include the postmortem link and action items.

sasha (People Ops): Adding a short note: we’ll include a 2-minute update on the new Private Deployment auditing policy (questions about rollout & opt-in). Document: <https://internal.redwood/policies/private-audit> — please read if you own Private customers.

elena (Product): One ask from my side — can we reserve 3 minutes for a short customer story (someone from CS) that shows Dedicated latency wins? That’s compelling.

sam (CEO): Love the customer story idea. @jasper can you confirm we won’t be blocked by any infra outages during demo?

jasper (Eng): Confirmed — demo region will be on Dedicated pool and isolated from the canary. Also I’ll have the quick remediation timeline on the slide.

dev-bot: Calendar invite posted: https://calendar.company/event/2789456123. Recording room link will be sent after the call.

maria (Marketing): Will share the FAQ draft by tomorrow morning for quick review.

sasha (People Ops): Thanks — final checklist: 1) Slides to me by Mon 5pm PT 2) Any Qs in this thread by Fri EOD 3) Caption request ✅ (we’ll enable live captions + transcript). We’ll record and publish in #all-hands and the company wiki after internal review.

[-- MEETING HAPPENED --]

sasha (People Ops): Recording is up: https://videos.company/redwood-allhands-2789456123 — captions and transcript processed. Quick takeaways: • Sam: reiterated focus on serving economics & reliability • Elena: Dedicated GA target = 6/15, Private onboarding pilot next month • Jasper: infra postmortem action items (scheduler revert, stricter canary gates) • Policy: Private auditing policy will be enabled by default for new onboarding; current customers have 30 days to opt-in/out.

maria (Marketing): Posted the one-pager here: https://docs.company/one-pager-dedicated-launch — feel free to comment.

elena (Product): Thanks team — action item: Product to publish rollout FAQ + timing in Product Hub by EOD Wed.

jasper (Eng): Action items assigned in the postmortem doc: https://incidents.company/scheduler-2028/postmortem — ping me if you want to pair on mitigations.

sasha (People Ops): Closing notes: if you were called out in shoutouts and want a public kudos post, DM me. If you missed the meeting, watch the recording and add any follow-up Qs here. :raised_hands:

sam (CEO): Great session, thanks all. Small ask: managers, please run a 15-minute sync with your teams this week to cascade the launch timelines and policy changes.
